model.scope: Supporting fake process and owned regular-file model; overlaps focused/canonical tests. No engine, device, subprocess, signals or native callbacks.

source_review: Launch rejects duplicate active or ambiguous ownership before touching its log; known executable errors release ownership and new attempts clear previous verdicts.
Under-lock descriptor/log identity validation precedes fake Popen; log descriptor lifetime and cleanup refusal prevent reuse of unconfirmed ownership.
Progress read sequence and expected process binding reject stale generation updates; threaded ordering is covered by existing focused regressions.
Completion evaluation rejects non-int exit codes, malformed record endings, conflicting method counters, skip/activity contradictions, failures and unverifiable log identity.
Bounded completion scans retain relevant table/progress/native context; existing strict-warning focused tests cover snapshot growth and exact scan boundary sizes.
Sleep-inhibitor genuine process interruptions still propagate while optional diagnostics cannot interrupt confirmed engine retirement; all56PASS11regressions retained.
limits: No fresh product defect proved; no speculative fix or old assertion change.
Supporting model/focused scenarios overlap canonical full-suite coverage; never sum counts as unique tests.

Model callbacks are scripted fakes and owned regular files. Focused existing tests use their fake fixtures and finite harmless helpers; no actual engine/device/inventory/mount/firmware/power/guest/network/remote/Docker operation.
Native, real-device, physical reconnect, firmware, full image qualification and pinned-browser verification are outside this bounded review.
Root retains independent validation and one serial full build/gate ownership.
